title: research-v1 pack over supplied sources with cited ids
goal: research-v1 pack over supplied sources with cited ids
acceptance: examples/research-v1.json: three to five short invented documents with ids in each prompt; the JSON answer carries the value and the source ids it relies on, both graded exactly; includes a two-source question, a newest-date-wins conflict and an unanswerable question expecting {"answer": null, "sources": []}
Area research; regression and holdout splits; live web research is out (recorded in the roadmap) and domain corpora stay with consumers
Passing and wrong fixtures prove exact grading, including a right answer with a wrong source id; index entry regenerated; public holdouts documented as exposed
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-26 after the owner accepted the proposal on its decision page, at observed agent speed for one-PR pack steps. Not a measurement. Larger than the other two packs for the source-id grading and the conflict cases.
